headlines.title: Megaspeed, chip firm at center of Nvidia scandal, pledges to cooperate with U.S. investigation
headlines.description: HONG KONG — Megaspeed, the tech company at the center of the Chinese spy scandal engulfing Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, said Thursday it will cooperate with U.S. government investigations.

headlines.title: Nvidia board meets over CEO’s future as chip giant reels from China spy scandal
headlines.description: The New York Times reported that Huang had a relationship with an Nvidia executive following reports that he’d had a relationship with a suspected Chinese spy.

headlines.title: Record credit card balances, fewer trips to McDonald’s: More signs of strain ahead of the holidays
headlines.description: Federal data shows savings rates have dipped below 4% of total income, well below pre-pandemic levels, revealing a fraying financial safety cushion.

headlines.title: Stanley Zabar, co-owner of iconic NYC food shop, dies at 94
headlines.description: He and his brother were tasked with carrying on their parents’ legacy through smoked fish and home-roasted coffee.

headlines.title: How to Save on Pet Expenses: Vet Visits, Medicines, Food, More
headlines.description: The cost of owning a pet is skyrocketing with average vet claims now 32% more expensive than 2020 and prices for pet food and treats up 20%, forcing some pet owners to make heartbreaking decisions. NBC’s Vicky Nguyen joins TODAY with strategies to save, including negotiating vet bills, staying on top of preventative care and even filling some pet medications at human pharmacies.

headlines.title: Anthropic eyes $1.4 trillion IPO valuation
headlines.description: Anthropic has begun marketing for its proposed IPO, targeting a $1.4 trillion valuation. NBC News’ Allie Canal reports on Anthropic’s approach to its stock market debut amid concerns about the stability of artificial intelligence.

headlines.title: Holiday Hiring Forecast: Where to Look for Short-Term Gigs
headlines.description: With Black Friday less than three weeks away, major companies are trying to fill thousands of seasonal jobs. NBC’s Vicky Nguyen joins TODAY with where to find them, the types of roles available, and how to stand out from the crowd.

headlines.title: Fall Maintenance: Tips to Save You Money on Unexpected Repairs
headlines.description: As colder months near and temperatures drop, now is a good time to tackle home and car maintenance that can lower bills, prevent costly repairs and save you from major overhauls during the winter. A new report says 85 percent of homeowners paid for repairs they did not expect in 2025, so NBC's Vicky Nguyen joins TODAY to share tips and tricks to make sure this season doesn't cost you.

headlines.title: Democrats won on affordability. Whether they can deliver it is a different story.
headlines.description: Fulfilling a campaign promise to bring down high prices is a lot harder than it sounds. Just ask Donald Trump.

headlines.title: Nvidia hires former acting U.S. attorney to probe Jensen Huang affair
headlines.description: Nvidia shares have tumbled by more than 10% since Monday, erasing almost $500 billion in market value.

headlines.title: Inflation still a headache for consumers despite cooling last month
headlines.description: Prices rose 0.4% in October, after the average cost of gas eased, bringing some relief to consumers who have been hammered by high prices for most of the year.

headlines.title: Gas prices fall below $4 per gallon for the first time since July
headlines.description: Pump prices dropped after oil prices plunged to their lowest point since August as President Donald Trump repeatedly signaled he didn’t plan to attack Iran.
